messages:
mara: Heads-up — planning thread for a phased admission + traffic-shaping playbook for Dedicated (reserved pools). Need to agree gating criteria before exec sync next Tue. :calendar:
devin: +1. can we define hard vs soft gating? customers asking for fast ramp but we need SLA guardrails.
samir: Suggest 3 gates: 1) infra readiness (pool capacity + prewarm), 2) policy (quota & burst rules), 3) ops (runbooks + rollback).
elaine: For policy gate: propose per-tenant admission profile with `min_commit`, `burst_allowance`, `latency_slo_ms`. Defaults and opt-ins.
mara: rough example config snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "admission_mode": "phased",
  "phases": [
    {"name":"pilot","min_commit":0.2,"burst_window_sec":120,"max_qps":50},
    {"name":"ramp","min_commit":0.5,"burst_window_sec":300,"max_qps":200},
    {"name":"steady","min_commit":1.0,"burst_window_sec":900,"max_qps":1000}
  ],
  "latency_slo_ms": 200
}
```
devin: That looks good. How do we map blobs to Reserved Pools? i.e., if tenant commits 0.5, are they pinned to a dedicated slot or pooled?
samir: Plan: commit % determines reserved weight. Weight -> guaranteed slots up to headroom. Spillover allowed into elastic buffer with throttling.
elaine: Need clear billing signals: committed vCPU/GPU capacity billed even if unused in pilot. Soft credits for pilot customers?
mara: Ops concerns: autoscale must respect phased admission. In pilot, autoscale should favor latency SLO over throughput to avoid noisy neighbors. ops-bot: incident playbook template created: https://go/redwood/playbooks/dedicated-phased-admission (draft) :clipboard:
devin: Can we encode fallback policy: if latency breaches for >3min, auto-failover to fallback-models + reduce burst_window by 50%?
samir: yes, fallback stack exists. we should also auto-throttle new sessions when breaches persist (token rate limiter).
elaine: Launch gating checklist draft: infra ✅, policy ✅ (draft), billing TBD, evals (prompt sets) TODO, ops runbook ✅ (draft).
mara: Action items: @devin add billing options & pilot credit proposal by EOD Fri; @samir write admission-to-pool mapping doc; @elaine prepare eval prompts for 3 customers; i'll consolidate and share a single-slide gating matrix.
devin: on it.
samir: will drop a doc link here when ready.
elaine: adding a few edge-cases: multi-tenant model variants (quantized vs fp16) should be part of admission profile — customers might accept lower quality for cost.
mara: good call. we'll include `quality_tier` in the profile.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Fri 23:00-01:00 UTC — any planned pilot cutovers should avoid that window. :warning:
mara: Ok locking this as the working thread. I’ll post gating matrix by Monday. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
